hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: [antigravity plugin] LEAN ROUTING: Two routing modes are supported: 'Always use Agy (strict)' and 'Use Agy when appropriate (soft)'. In strict mode (effective default until user choice), Claude conducts and all substantive work (discovery, edits, review, verification, Git, research, media, subagents, terminal) is delegated to agy/Gemini. A safe compound command that only prepares an Agy prompt with cd/cat/Get-Content and then invokes an Agy worker is allowed; unrelated or destructive shell chains remain denied. In soft mode, reminders are advisory. Default to `--tier flash` (latest Flash High); `--tier flash-medium` is an explicit option for clearly simple work. Reserve Pro for exceptional escalation. Prefer direct wrappers over a native Claude subagent. For repository exploration use `agy-scout`; for diff verification use `agy-review`, and ingest compact digests rather than raw files/diffs. Keep inline Agy prompts below 24,000 characters and 3,500 words; over-budget work must be compressed, split across independent workers, or piped via `agy-delegate ... -`/a task file. The hook and wrapper enforce this transport safety ceiling. Give real workers at least a 30-minute hard timeout, using 45–60 minutes for broad multi-file or build-heavy work; reserve short limits for probes. Run the smallest sufficient test/build/lint gate. One builder, one blind verifier, and at most one repair; no agent loops. Preserve user changes and require authorization for commit/push or external/destructive actions. `AGY_ALWAYS_YOLO=1` or `always_yolo=on` grants broad machine access. If a Gemini run fails, inspect both 5h and 7d quotas; either at or below 2% is depleted. Never switch models automatically: ask the user whether to kill stalled Agy workers and continue with Claude Sonnet 4.6, or keep them alive and check both windows every 10 minutes. A user-approved Sonnet fallback must do the task itself without nested agents; the wrapper requires a direct-completion status and evidence receipt instead of trusting exit 0 alone. Append newly emitted English 75/50/25/10% quota advisories. Full details are in the `antigravity` skill.
